metadata.title: Add isolation counseling for cough during COVID circulation without rapid testing

clinical_intent: When COVID is circulating and rapid tests are unavailable, children with cough but without danger signs should receive isolation and household protection advice without delaying standard pneumonia assessment and treatment.
new_or_changed_inputs: Record whether the child currently has cough.
Use the local deployment context indicating that COVID is circulating.
new_predicates_needed: COVID-circulation context is active for this deployment.
changed_classifications: Add a non-urgent isolation counseling output for cough during COVID circulation.
changed_actions: Give household protection and isolation counseling when cough is present without danger signs and without fast-breathing pneumonia.
priority_rules: Fast-breathing pneumonia treatment remains higher priority than isolation counseling.
missingness_rules: If cough status is missing, ask the cough question before classification.
If the COVID-circulation context is unavailable, use the program default constant.
stockout_device_rules: No COVID rapid test branch is introduced in this change; standard clinical logic remains in use.
safety_invariants: Isolation counseling must never delay urgent referral.
Isolation counseling must not replace fast-breathing pneumonia treatment.
counseling_messages: Explain home isolation, masking where feasible, hand hygiene, and return precautions.
follow_up: Return promptly if danger signs develop or breathing worsens.
data_capture_reporting: Record that isolation counseling was given.
sunset_review_condition: Review when rapid testing becomes available or the COVID-circulation advisory is retired.
